english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to express a personal judgment or assessment.

exampleSentences.english: I deem this restaurant pretty good.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我覺得呢間餐廳幾好食。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for thinking, having an impression, or finding that something seems a certain way.

exampleSentences.english: I feel this movie is pretty good.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2

english.note: Use this for expressing an opinion or judging that someone or something is a certain way.

exampleSentences.english: I think this restaurant is pretty good.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2

english.note: Use 覺得 when “find” means forming an opinion or judging something to be a certain way.

exampleSentences.english: I find this restaurant pretty good.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我覺得呢間餐廳幾好食。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

english.note: Use this instead of 相信 when “believe” means giving your opinion or saying what you think.

exampleSentences.english: I believe it will rain today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

english.note: Use this when something gives a person a particular impression or seems a certain way to them.

exampleSentences.english: The restaurant’s decor can strike you as very stylish.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修令人覺得好有格調。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 gaak3 diu6
